gloss: to improve; to enhance; to raise

definitions.gloss: to improve; to enhance; to raise
definitions.explanation: To cause something to improve or reach a higher level. Used for skills, quality, performance, efficiency, and other measurable attributes. The causative form of 向上する, emphasizing that someone or something actively brings about the improvement.

examples.japanese: ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{向上|こうじょう}させる。

⟦{社員|しゃいん}→社員：03065_shain⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{向上|こうじょう}させる⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{研修|けんしゅう}→研修：05322_kenshuu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: We conducted training to improve employees' abilities.

examples.japanese: ⟦サービス→サービス：01531_saabisu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{質|しつ}→質：01425_shitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{向上|こうじょう}させる⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧、⟦{顧客|こきゃく}→顧客：08632_kokyaku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{意見|いけん}→意見：01303_iken⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{積極的|せっきょくてき}→積極的：01585_sekkyokuteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{取|と}り{入|い}れている→取り入れる：04221_toriireru⟧。
examples.english: We actively incorporate customer feedback to enhance the quality of our service.

notes:
The causative form of ⟦{向上|こうじょう}する→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧ (to improve, intransitive). While ⟦{向上|こうじょう}する→向上する：18997_koujousuru⟧ means something improves on its own, {向上|こうじょう}させる means someone actively causes the improvement. This is a very common pattern in business and education.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{向上|こうじょう}させる: to improve quality
- ⟦{効率|こうりつ}→効率：11794_kouritsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{向上|こうじょう}させる: to improve efficiency
- ⟦{能力|のうりょく}→能力：03541_nouryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{向上|こうじょう}させる: to enhance abilities
- ⟦{生産性|せいさんせい}→生産性：05574_seisansei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{向上|こうじょう}させる: to increase productivity

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{改善|かいぜん}する→改善する：26828_kaizensuru⟧: to improve — focuses on fixing problems or correcting defects
- ⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧: to raise, to heighten — native Japanese verb with similar meaning; more versatile
- ⟦{上達|じょうたつ}させる→上達する：17981_joutatsusuru⟧: to improve (someone's skill) — specifically for personal skills and abilities
